title: DecisionLogEntry
description: Entry-level contract of the opID-to-decision one-way hash chain (audit chain, Phase A part). Each entry links to the previous entry via SHA-256 of its canonical form; the genesis entry uses an empty prevEntryHash.

kind.description: What sort of decision this line records, in the recording ecosystem's own vocabulary (iterate uses round_start / review_result / atomic_fix / …, the GlassPane fork records tool executions). Deliberately NOT an enum: the kernel does not own either vocabulary, and enumerating them would make every new producer kind a kernel release. See the module doc in src/decision-log-entry.ts.

round.description: Loop position the decision belongs to, when the producer counts rounds. Optional because a one-off tool execution is not part of a round.

dimension.description: The dimension this decision was serving, using the same id rule as dimension-context (DIMENSION_ID_PATTERN / DIMENSION_ID_MAX_LENGTH, imported not restated). This is what lets a recorded decision count toward 'N/M dimensions verified' from either ecosystem.

payload.description: Structured detail carried alongside the human-readable summary — the field the legacy 'data' object maps onto. NOTE A BOUND THE SCHEMA CANNOT STATE: the canonical-JSON form of this object is limited to PAYLOAD_MAX_CANONICAL_LENGTH (8192) characters by the TypeScript validator and the Python port, because an unbounded field in a hash-chained ledger lets a line's bytes and digest grow without limit. JSON Schema has no way to bound serialized length, so this is a documented divergence, pinned as a named case in kernel/test/decision-log-entry.test.mjs rather than silently allowed.
